# Devashish Juyal

> AI engineer in New York. I turn rough ideas into AI products people can trust.

Personal site and portfolio. Each page below is also available as markdown.

## Pages

- [Home](https://juyal-devashish.github.io/index.md): who I am, what I’ve built and where I’ve worked
- [Reading shelf](https://juyal-devashish.github.io/papers.md): papers I’ve read, with a takeaway for each

## Projects

- [Sama4](https://www.sama4.online/): News that explains itself, right beside the story.
- [Inline](https://www.inlinetutor.com/): A writing tutor that asks questions about a draft instead of rewriting it. In beta with real students.
- [AI operator release gate](https://evosdemo.vercel.app): Lets an AI agent earn trust step by step, and lose it quickly.
- [Health-first voice onboarding](https://eatopia-demo.vercel.app): A nutrition app’s sign-up, rebuilt around Apple Health and your voice.
- [Agentic Adjudication](https://github.com/juyal-devashish/Agentic-Adjudication): AI agents prepare clinical-trial safety cases; people make every call.
- [Sequential watermark detection](https://juyal-devashish.github.io/LLM-Sequential-Watermarking/): Spotting AI-written text with far less computation.
